description:
In an alternate modern era where Silla failed to unify the Three Kingdoms, Goguryeo, Baekje, and Silla remain in fierce confrontation. As a symbol of peace, the three nations establish Three Kingdoms Peace High School in the Demilitarized Zone. On the day of the inaugural entrance ceremony, where the children of each country's political and business elites gather, sharp gunshots ring out through the auditorium. Terrorist leader Kim Huirak takes the students hostage and demands the independence of Gaya, declaring ruthlessly that if the demand is not met, one student will be chosen by lottery every night at 7 PM and their murder livestreamed to the entire world. Trapped inside an air-raid shelter, the terrified students size each other up to find the first sacrificial victim. The finger points toward Munhui, an orphan admitted by a mistake from the Baekje Office of Education, and the students nominate her to die tomorrow. "We're falling into the abyss. All together." At that moment, Munhui's single remark turns the tables. In a school transformed from a symbol of peace into a hellish battlefield, a final life-or-death lottery begins.
